title: SpharmReco
description: Spherical Harmonics Reconstruction from a set of harmonics and their corresponding coefficients.

input_surface.description: Surface that provides the topology of the mesh (nodes' connections). TYPE specifies the input surface type.
input_surface.title: Input Surface

bases_prefix.description: Prefix of files containing the bases functions (spherical harmonics). These files are generated with SpharmDeco.
bases_prefix.title: Bases Prefix

coefficients.description: Coefficients files used to recompose data columns. Multiple coefficient files can be specified by repeating the option.
coefficients.title: Coefficient Files

output_prefix.description: Write out the reconstructed data into dataset PREFIX. The output contains N columns; one for each COEF file.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

output_surface.description: Write out a new surface with reconstructed coordinates. Requires N to be a multiple of 3.
output_surface.title: Output Surface

smoothing.description: Smoothing parameter (0 .. 0.001) weighing the contribution of higher order harmonics
smoothing.title: Smoothing Parameter
